name: MapAnything, Apache variant (Meta)
usage: Multi-view 3D reconstruction: metric points, depth, camera poses and intrinsics from one or more photos (stereo pairs included)

licence.note: no LICENSE file; the tag was wrong until 04.02.2026 (GitHub #139). The non-Apache variants are CC BY-NC 4.0

size_gb.note: safetensors; older weights in map-anything-apache-v1, 2.25 GB

runtimes.value: PyTorch on MPS (PR #131, about March 2026); not on PyPI; an mlx-vlm port (PR #2400) was closed unmerged on 01.10.2026

web.scope: Over 12 months old: comments since 15.05.2026. Hacker News, Hugging Face discussions, GitHub issues of facebookresearch/map-anything. Reddit not readable. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: Used in production as a calibration cross-check; one report of inconsistent metric scale between runs; a dependency conflict; licence tag fixed in February 2026.
web.verdict: Only permissively licensed multi-view reconstruction model found; thin feedback

comments.text: "Models like MapAnything/MoGe predict calibration params directly… We still calibrate manually on-site, but mainly to validate these models actually hold up." ([HN, 09.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48465090))

With stereo visual-odometry poses fed in, metric scale inconsistent with a LiDAR map between runs; the maintainer says depth is metric and is investigating ([#168, 09.09.2026](https://github.com/facebookresearch/map-anything/issues/168)). NumPy conflict with the vggt-omega extra ([#160, 03.06.2026](https://github.com/facebookresearch/map-anything/issues/160)).

Licence history: "Apache? It is cc-by-nc-4.0!" ([HF #1, 26.12.2025](https://huggingface.co/facebook/map-anything-apache/discussions/1)), fixed per [GitHub #139](https://github.com/facebookresearch/map-anything/issues/139) (04.02.2026).
